name: Brightline Labs
tagline: Got a big idea? Tell Brightline Labs and get a quick, honest take.

copy.headline: Got a big idea? Let's work out what it needs.
copy.lead: Tell us what you're building and we'll send back a quick, honest take on how {shortName} can help. It takes about two minutes.
points: Not sure yet? That's fine. We'll help you shape it.
No pitch, no pricing, nothing to sign.
copy.goalHint: A sentence or two is plenty. Rough is great.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. I built an app with an AI tool and people are loving it, but I'm not sure it's ready for more users.
copy.finePrint: No pitch, no pricing, no budget questions. Please don't share passwords, keys or customer data.
